mapper.insert: insert into risk_external_data_access_log (customer_no, provider_name, query_status, data_available, external_risk_score, data_source) values (#{customer_no}, #{provider_name}, #{query_status}, #{data_available}, #{external_risk_score}, #{data_source})
insert into risk_ai_chat_log (customer_no, question, answer_type, external_status) values (#{customer_no}, #{question}, #{answer_type}, #{external_status})
mapper.select: select count(*) as query_count_today, ifnull(sum(data_available = 1), 0) as available_count_today, ifnull(sum(query_status = 'UNAVAILABLE'), 0) as unavailable_count_today, ifnull(sum(query_status = 'NOT_ENABLED'), 0) as not_enabled_count_today from risk_external_data_access_log where requested_at >= current_date
select customer_no, provider_name, query_status, data_available, external_risk_score, data_source, requested_at from risk_external_data_access_log order by id desc limit 1

select snapshot_date, model_name, rule_count, customer_total, average_risk_score, extreme_risk_count, high_risk_count, warning_customer_count, forecast_upgrade_count, external_query_count, external_available_count, external_unavailable_count, created_at from risk_model_monitor_snapshot order by snapshot_date desc, id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_model_monitor_snapshot (snapshot_date, model_name, rule_count, customer_total, average_risk_score, extreme_risk_count, high_risk_count, warning_customer_count, forecast_upgrade_count, external_query_count, external_available_count, external_unavailable_count) values (#{snapshot_date}, #{model_name}, #{rule_count}, #{customer_total}, #{average_risk_score}, #{extreme_risk_count}, #{high_risk_count}, #{warning_customer_count}, #{forecast_upgrade_count}, #{external_query_count}, #{external_available_count}, #{external_unavailable_count}) on duplicate key update rule_count = values(rule_count), customer_total = values(customer_total), average_risk_score = values(average_risk_score), extreme_risk_count = values(extreme_risk_count), high_risk_count = values(high_risk_count), warning_customer_count = values(warning_customer_count), forecast_upgrade_count = values(forecast_upgrade_count), external_query_count = values(external_query_count), external_available_count = values(external_available_count), external_unavailable_count = values(external_unavailable_count)
mapper.select: select d.product_type, count(*) as drawdown_count, ifnull(sum(d.outstanding_principal_amount), 0) as outstanding_amount, ifnull(sum(ov.overdue_count), 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(sum(dd.default_count), 0) as debt_default_count, ifnull(sum(dd.default_exposure_amount), 0) as default_exposure_amount from corporate_credit_drawdown d left join ( select drawdown_no, count(*) as overdue_count from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 group by drawdown_no ) ov on ov.drawdown_no = d.drawdown_no left join ( select drawdown_no, count(*) as default_count, sum(default_exposure_amount) as default_exposure_amount from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and default_status = 'ACTIVE' group by drawdown_no ) dd on dd.drawdown_no = d.drawdown_no where d.deleted_flag = 0 group by d.product_type order by debt_default_count desc, overdue_count desc, outstanding_amount desc
